Subject: Discovery follow-up + VP/CTO intro - Acme Health

Hi Samantha -

Thanks again for taking the time today - really appreciated the candid conversation about your current inference costs and the roadmap for clinical summarization. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: you currently run a mix of on-prem and cloud GPUs; main priorities are lowering per-token costs, predictable latency for near-real-time features, and SOC2-compliant audit logging.
- Short-term ask: exec alignment with Rajiv (CTO) to confirm procurement and risk questions.
- Technical next step: 60-minute technical deep dive/demo with our lead systems engineer to validate throughput numbers on a representative workload.

Would Rajiv be available for a brief 30-45 minute exec alignment to unblock procurement? Proposed times (PT):
- Wed, Jun 16 - 10:00-10:45 AM PT
- Thu, Jun 17 - 2:00-2:45 PM PT

For the technical deep dive, we can do a separate 60 minute slot the following week (I copied suggested slots in calendar invite if any of the above work).

I'm attaching a short overview (Redwood-Platform-Overview.pdf) with the specific items we discussed. Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2027-0123

If those times work, I can loop in Elliot (engineer) to prepare a demo that matches your latency & retention constraints.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole

Hi Rajiv / Samantha -

Thanks for the invite and looking forward to the exec alignment. For the technical deep dive, I'll prepare a demo focused on:
- end-to-end latency (95/99 pct) for a 512-token summarization workload
- throughput scaling across mixed on-prem + cloud (we'll include a representative 10K daily active users load)
- audit logging and key management options (KMS/HSM) for HIPAA/SOC2 needs

A couple asks to make the deep dive maximally useful:
1) Can you share a small sample of the typical payload size (token estimates) and expected concurrency?
2) Any specific network/environment constraints (VPC peering, egress limits)?

I've also uploaded a short prep doc here: https://drive.redwood.com/tech-deep-dive-prep - feel free to drop notes.

Cheers,
